tool_schemas.name: coingecko_get_coin_price_detailed
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the current price for a single CoinGecko coin_id directly from CoinGecko and returns a map of vs_currencies to price, optionally including market cap, 24h volume, 24h change, and last_updated_at fields exactly as CoinGecko provides them. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if coin_id is missing/empty, if vs_currencies is not a string or array of strings, or if unsupported parameter types are provided; raises NOT_FOUND when CoinGecko does not recognize the coin_id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the upstream provider rejects our request credentials, RATE_LIMITED when CoinGecko or this service throttles requests, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on transient provider failures/timeouts.

coin_id.description: CoinGecko coin ID ('bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'cardano'). Use search_assets to find exact IDs for any cryptocurrency

vs_currencies.description: Target currencies for price data (usd, eur, btc, eth). Multiple currencies supported as array

include_market_cap.description: Include market cap data for valuation analysis

include_24hr_change.description: Include 24h price change for momentum analysis

tool_schemas.name: coingecko_get_market_chart_detailed
tool_schemas.description: Returns CoinGecko market chart history for the given coin_id in the requested vs_currency over the specified days window, including CoinGecko’s native arrays (e.g., prices, market_caps, total_volumes) and interval behavior when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if coin_id is missing/empty, if days is not a number/string accepted by CoinGecko, or if interval is provided but not a valid CoinGecko interval string; raises NOT_FOUND when the coin_id is unknown to CoinGecko. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the upstream provider rejects our request credentials, RATE_LIMITED when CoinGecko or this service throttles requests, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on provider failures/timeouts.

coin_id.description: CoinGecko coin ID ('bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'cardano'). Use search_assets to find exact IDs

vs_currency.description: Target currency for price data (usd, eur, btc). USD recommended for cross-asset comparisons

days.description: Number of days of data (1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365, max). Use shorter periods for intraday analysis, longer for trend assessment

interval.description: Data interval (daily, hourly). Hourly for detailed analysis, daily for long-term trends. Auto-selected if not specified

tool_schemas.name: coingecko_get_trending_coins
tool_schemas.description: Returns CoinGecko’s current “trending” coins list derived from CoinGecko user search activity, as provided by CoinGecko at request time (no paging). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR only if unexpected parameters are supplied (the random_string placeholder is ignored for compatibility). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the upstream provider rejects our request credentials, RATE_LIMITED when CoinGecko or this service throttles requests, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on provider failures/timeouts.

tool_schemas.name: get_top_protocols
tool_schemas.description: Returns a ranked list of the top DeFi protocols by TVL, optionally filtered by category and/or chain, with formatted TVL, 24h change, and chain distribution fields for quick discovery (no paging; result size controlled by limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is outside 1–100 or if filter values are not strings; raises NOT_FOUND if category or chain filters are provided but match no protocols. Raises RATE_LIMITED when this service enforces request throttling and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the underlying provider data cannot be fetched or normalized.

limit.description: Number of top protocols to return (1-100, default: 10). Use smaller values for quick insights, larger for comprehensive market overview

category.description: Filter by category ('Dexes', 'Lending', 'Yield', 'CDP'). Use exact category names for precise filtering

chain.description: Filter by blockchain ('Ethereum', 'BSC', 'Polygon', 'Arbitrum'). Use exact chain names for accurate results

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_protocols_paginated
tool_schemas.description: Lists DeFi protocols using page/limit pagination and returns the requested slice sorted by sort_by and sort_order, along with pagination metadata (page, limit, and total/result counts when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page < 1, limit is outside 1–100, or sort_by/sort_order is not one of the allowed enums; raises NOT_FOUND if the requested page is beyond the available result set. Raises RATE_LIMITED when this service throttles list traversal and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream protocol dataset cannot be retrieved.

page.description: Page number (starting from 1). Use for iterating through large protocol datasets

limit.description: Number of protocols per page (1-100, default: 20). Larger values for fewer API calls, smaller for faster responses

sort_by.description: Sort protocols by field (tvl for market cap ranking, change_1d/7d for performance analysis)

sort_order.description: Sort order (desc for top performers, asc for reverse ranking)

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_protocols
tool_schemas.description: ⚠️ DEPRECATED: Use defillama_get_top_protocols or defillama_get_protocols_paginated instead. Gets DeFi protocols (limited to prevent overwhelming responses).

limit.description: Maximum number of protocols to return (1-50, default: 10)

tool_schemas.name: defillama_search_protocols
tool_schemas.description: Searches the protocol universe for matches to query (name/symbol/category/keywords) and returns up to limit results sorted by TVL, optionally constrained by category_filter, chain_filter, and min_tvl. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, if limit is outside 1–50, or if min_tvl is not a number; raises NOT_FOUND when no protocols match the query+filters. Raises RATE_LIMITED when this service throttles repeated searches and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream dataset cannot be fetched or searched.

query.description: Search query (protocol name, symbol, category, or keyword)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default: 10)

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_tvl
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical TVL time-series for a resolved protocol over a date range (start_date/end_date) or a rolling window (days_limit), sampled down to max_data_points using sample_strategy and optionally augmented with analytics and experimental predictions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if protocol is missing/empty, if dates are not YYYY-MM-DD, if start_date > end_date, if max_data_points is outside 10–2000, if days_limit is outside 7–1095, or if granularity/sample_strategy is not one of the allowed enums. Raises NOT_FOUND when the protocol cannot be resolved to a supported data source or no TVL series exists for the requested range, CONFLICT when mutually incompatible time selectors are provided (e.g., both explicit dates and days_limit), RATE_LIMITED for expensive historical requests, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when underlying providers fail to supply required data.

protocol.description: Protocol name or identifier (e.g., 'Uniswap', 'AAVE', 'Compound', 'uni', 'maker'). Automatically resolves across data sources.

max_data_points.description: Maximum number of data points to return (10-2000, default: 500). Lower values = faster responses. Use 100-200 for quick analysis, 500+ for detailed analysis.

days_limit.description: Maximum number of days to fetch (7-1095). Only applies if start_date/end_date not specified. Use 30-90 for recent analysis, 365+ for long-term trends.

sample_strategy.description: How to sample data when truncating: 'even' = evenly spaced, 'recent' = prioritize recent data, 'weekly' = weekly intervals

include_analytics.description: Include growth metrics, volatility analysis, and insights

tool_schemas.name: list_supported_protocols
tool_schemas.description: Lists the protocols pre-configured for unified TVL aggregation, optionally filtered by category and chain, and returns either a compact list or detailed entries when show_details=true (no paging). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category/chain are not strings or show_details is not boolean; raises NOT_FOUND when filters are provided but match no configured protocols. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR if the supported-protocol catalog cannot be loaded.

tool_schemas.name: resolve_protocol_name
tool_schemas.description: Resolves an input protocol query to the canonical protocol identifier used by the unified TVL system and returns the chosen match along with any ambiguity/alternatives when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the query is missing/empty or not a string; raises NOT_FOUND when no configured or provider-backed protocol matches the query. Raises CONFLICT when the query is ambiguous and cannot be deterministically resolved without additional disambiguation, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when resolution depends on a provider lookup that fails.

query.description: Protocol name, symbol, or alias to resolve (e.g., 'uni', 'maker', 'pancake')

show_alternatives.description: Show alternative matches if exact match not found

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_chain_historical_tvl
tool_schemas.description: Get historical TVL data for blockchain ecosystems to track capital flows and identify mercenary capital patterns across chains.

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_protocol_fees_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the requested protocol’s historical fees or revenue time series (data_type = dailyFees or dailyRevenue) for the optional [start_timestamp, end_timestamp] window, as provided by DeFiLlama. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if protocol is empty, timestamps are not Unix seconds, or start_timestamp > end_timestamp; raises NOT_FOUND if the protocol slug is unknown or the provider has no fees/revenue dataset for it; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT when DeFiLlama cannot be reached, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream or server quotas are exceeded.

data_type.description: Data type to retrieve: 'dailyFees' for fees paid by users, 'dailyRevenue' for protocol revenue

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_yields_historical
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical yield/APY snapshots for the specified DeFiLlama yields pool over the last N days (days, default 30). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pool_id is empty or days is outside 1–365; raises NOT_FOUND if the pool_id does not exist or has no historical series; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT on provider failures and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

pool_id.description: Pool ID from yields API (use yields search first to find pool IDs)

days.description: Number of days of historical data

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_stablecoin_historical
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical stablecoin circulation/supply data for the given stablecoin symbol, optionally filtered to a specific chain, for the optional [start_timestamp, end_timestamp] window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if stablecoin is empty, timestamps are invalid, or start_timestamp > end_timestamp; raises NOT_FOUND if the stablecoin (or requested chain for that stablecoin) is not recognized by the provider or has no series; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT when DeFiLlama is unavailable and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

tool_schemas.name: defillama_compare_protocols_historical
tool_schemas.description: Returns aligned historical TVL series for 2–5 protocol slugs over the optional [start_timestamp, end_timestamp] window, and when normalize_to_start is true also returns the same series rebased to 100 at the first datapoint for each protocol. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if protocols has fewer than 2 or more than 5 items, contains empty/duplicate slugs, or timestamps are invalid (including start_timestamp > end_timestamp); raises NOT_FOUND if any requested protocol slug is unknown or lacks TVL history; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT on provider failures and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

protocols.description: Array of protocol slugs to compare (2-5 protocols)

normalize_to_start.description: Normalize all protocols to 100 at start date for relative comparison

tool_schemas.name: get_dex_volume
tool_schemas.description: Looks up the given protocol across spot DEX and perpetuals/derivatives sources and returns current volume metrics, optionally including historical series (include_historical, capped by days_limit) and optional chain-level breakdown (include_breakdown). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if protocol is empty or days_limit is outside 7–365; raises NOT_FOUND if the protocol cannot be matched to either a spot or derivatives venue; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT when upstream volume providers fail and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

protocol.description: Protocol name or slug (e.g., 'hyperliquid', 'gmx', 'uniswap', 'curve'). Will search both spot and perpetuals data automatically

include_historical.description: Include historical volume data for trend analysis

include_breakdown.description: Include chain-level volume breakdown for multi-chain protocols

days_limit.description: Number of days of historical data to include (7-365, default: 90)

tool_schemas.name: get_derivatives_overview
tool_schemas.description: Returns a ranked list of derivatives/perpetuals protocols with volume metrics, optionally filtered by chain and/or min_volume_24h, limited by limit (default 20), and optionally including per-chain breakdown. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is outside 1–100 or min_volume_24h is negative; raises NOT_FOUND if a chain filter is supplied and no protocols match that chain (or no protocols satisfy the filters); raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT on upstream failures and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of top protocols to return (1-100, default: 20)

include_breakdown.description: Include chain-level volume breakdown for multi-chain protocols

min_volume_24h.description: Minimum 24h volume in USD to filter protocols

tool_schemas.name: get_derivatives_volume
tool_schemas.description: Returns volume metrics for a single derivatives/perpetuals protocol, optionally including a historical series for the last days_limit days (include_historical). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if protocol is empty or days_limit is outside 7–365; raises NOT_FOUND if the protocol slug/name cannot be resolved to a derivatives venue or has no volume dataset; raises UPSTREAM_ERROR or TIMEOUT when upstream providers fail and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

days_limit.description: Number of days of historical data to include (7-365, default: 90)

tool_schemas.name: defillama_get_cache_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current DeFiLlama cache health and summary statistics, and when include_details is true includes per-key/per-endpoint metrics such as hit rate and refresh timing where available. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if cache diagnostics are restricted in the deployment environment; raises INTERNAL_ERROR if cache instrumentation is unavailable or corrupted; raises RATE_LIMITED if the status endpoint is polled beyond configured limits.

include_details.description: Include detailed cache statistics and performance metrics

tool_schemas.name: defillama_refresh_cache
tool_schemas.description: Requests a manual invalidation/refresh of the selected cache_type (protocols or all) and returns an acknowledgement of the refresh request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if cache_type is not one of the supported values; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to perform cache invalidation; raises CONFLICT if a refresh job for the same cache scope is already running or the cache is in a locked state, and raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the refresh job cannot be scheduled.

cache_type.description: Type of cache to refresh: 'protocols' for protocol list only, 'all' to clear all caches

tool_schemas.name: defillama_search_cached_protocols
tool_schemas.description: Searches the locally cached DeFiLlama protocol index for the given query and returns up to limit matches (default 10), with optional expanded fields when show_details is true; results are limited by limit (no pagination token is supported). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or limit is outside 1–50; raises NOT_FOUND if the cache is empty/uninitialized or no protocols match the query; raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the cache index is unavailable.

query.description: Search query to find protocols (name, symbol, category, etc.)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: defillama_analyze_cache_performance
tool_schemas.description: Analyzes recent DeFiLlama-backed cache activity and returns performance statistics (e.g., hit/miss behavior, refresh latency) and, when show_recommendations is true, a set of optimization recommendations based on the observed usage patterns. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if show_recommendations is not a boolean, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access operational metrics, and RATE_LIMITED if performance analysis is throttled to protect the service.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_price
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided asset (symbol, name, or contract address) and returns the latest price in vs_currency, optionally including market-cap/volume/24h-change when include_market_data is true, using the requested sources or automatic multi-source fallback when sources is omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid asset, invalid vs_currency, unknown sources values, or a non-boolean include_market_data; raises NOT_FOUND when the asset cannot be resolved or no source can provide a current price for it. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access price tools and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/provider or server quotas are exceeded.

asset.description: Cryptocurrency symbol (BTC, ETH), name (Bitcoin, Ethereum), or contract address. Automatically resolves across all supported data sources

vs_currency.description: Target currency (usd, eur, btc, etc.). USD recommended for cross-protocol comparisons

include_market_data.description: Include market cap, volume, and 24h change data for comprehensive analysis

sources.description: Specific data sources to use (coingecko, cmc, defillama). Automatic selection if not specified

tool_schemas.name: compare_prices
tool_schemas.description: Resolves each entry in assets and returns a side-by-side list of current prices in vs_currency with the selected sort_by ordering applied to the returned set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if assets is not an array of 2–20 items, any asset entry is empty/invalid, vs_currency is invalid, or sort_by is not one of the supported fields; raises NOT_FOUND when none of the provided assets can be resolved/priced (unresolvable assets may be omitted or returned with an error field depending on availability). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted and RATE_LIMITED if the request exceeds service or provider rate limits.

assets.description: Array of cryptocurrency symbols, names, or addresses to compare (2-20 items). Mix different asset types for comprehensive analysis

vs_currency.description: Target currency for comparison (usd, eur, btc). USD recommended for relative valuation

sort_by.description: Sort results by metric (market_cap for size ranking, change_24h for performance ranking)

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns a time-series of historical price points for the resolved asset between start_date and end_date (inclusive) in vs_currency at the requested granularity, optionally including volume and market cap series when enabled, using the specified sources or automatic aggregation for best coverage. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid date formats, start_date after end_date, unsupported granularity, invalid vs_currency, invalid sources, or non-boolean include_volume/include_market_cap; raises NOT_FOUND when the asset cannot be resolved or no historical data exists for the requested window. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed and RATE_LIMITED when upstream or server quotas are exceeded.

asset.description: Cryptocurrency symbol (BTC, ETH), name (Bitcoin, Ethereum), or contract address. Automatically resolves across all data sources

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 30 days ago). Use recent dates for short-term analysis, older dates for long-term trends

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today). Typically current date for up-to-date analysis

granularity.description: Data granularity (hourly for intraday analysis, daily for standard trends, weekly/monthly for long-term patterns)

vs_currency.description: Target currency (usd, eur, btc). USD recommended for cross-asset comparisons

include_volume.description: Include trading volume for liquidity analysis and trend confirmation

include_market_cap.description: Include market cap data for valuation analysis and size comparison

sources.description: Specific data sources to use (coingecko, cmc, defillama). Automatic selection for best coverage if not specified

tool_schemas.name: get_price_analytics
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns derived analytics for the resolved asset over the selected period in vs_currency (e.g., returns, volatility/trend summaries), and includes technical indicators only when include_technical_indicators is true and sufficient data exists. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid asset, unsupported period, invalid vs_currency, or non-boolean include_technical_indicators; raises CONFLICT when technical indicators are requested but the available historical series does not contain enough points for the calculations. Raises NOT_FOUND when the asset cannot be resolved or no price history is available for the period, plus UNAUTHORIZED and RATE_LIMITED under the usual access and quota rules.

asset.description: Cryptocurrency symbol, name, or contract address. Supports all major cryptocurrencies

period.description: Analysis period (7d for short-term momentum, 30d for monthly trends, 90d for quarterly analysis, 1y for long-term patterns)

vs_currency.description: Target currency for analysis (usd, eur, btc). USD recommended for standard financial metrics

include_technical_indicators.description: Include technical indicators (SMA, RSI, Bollinger Bands). Requires sufficient data points

tool_schemas.name: search_assets
tool_schemas.description: Performs a smart search across normalized assets/protocol metadata using query, returning up to limit matches (default 10) optionally filtered by category and asset_type; results are not paged and are truncated to the limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, limit is outside 1–50, or asset_type is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use search and RATE_LIMITED if query throughput exceeds server limits.

query.description: Search query (partial name, symbol, category, etc.)

category.description: Filter by category (defi, layer-1, stablecoin, etc.)

tool_schemas.name: get_assets_by_category
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of assets mapped to the requested category, and when include_prices is true also returns current price data in vs_currency for each asset where available; results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid category, invalid vs_currency, or non-boolean include_prices; raises NOT_FOUND when the category does not exist or has no assets. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if access is not permitted and RATE_LIMITED when category lookups or upstream price enrichment exceeds quotas.

tool_schemas.name: ping
tool_schemas.description: Echoes an optional message and returns basic server status/health information for connectivity checks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message is provided but is not a string. Raises RATE_LIMITED if health checks are being throttled and UNAUTHORIZED only when the deployment restricts status access.

tool_schemas.name: list_assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized asset metadata with optional filters and cursor-style pagination. Returns only assets the caller is permitted to view; refuses invalid filter combinations or out-of-range pagination.

api_key.description: Scry API key used to authenticate this request.

category.description: Filter to assets whose categories contain this category slug/name.

contract_address.description: Filter by contract address (normalized hex where applicable).

provider.description: Filter to assets that have a provider id for the selected provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (1–50).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: get_asset
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single asset by id and returns its full normalized metadata. Refuses if the asset does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

api_key.description: Scry API key used to authenticate this request.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_asset
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new asset or updates an existing one by id. Returns the stored asset record. Refuses lifecycle transitions not allowed by the asset status state machine and rejects invalid provider id payloads.

api_key.description: Scry API key used to authenticate this request.

id.description: Asset primary key; if omitted a new id is generated.

contract_address.description: Contract address for token assets (if applicable).

categories.description: List of category tags/slugs associated with the asset.

provider_ids.description: Provider identifier map used for resolution and upstream joins (e.g., {"coingecko_coin_id":"bitcoin"}).

status.description: Asset lifecycle status; transition must be valid (e.g., disabled→active allowed, active→disabled allowed).

tool_schemas.name: update_cache_entry_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a cache entry lifecycle status (valid/expired/invalidated/error) for controlled invalidation or recovery. Returns the updated cache entry. Refuses illegal transitions and refuses updates to entries the caller is not entitled to manage.

api_key.description: Scry API key used to authenticate this request.

status.description: New cache entry status; must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the provided credential, including granted scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses invalid or revoked credentials.

api_key.description: Scry API key used to authenticate this request.

metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP search/analytics server that aggregates crypto market data (prices, charts, categories) and DeFi ecosystem data (protocols, TVL, fees, yields, volumes) from external providers like CoinGecko and DeFiLlama. It stores normalized entity metadata (assets, protocols) plus time-
